              Galaxy A57 5G - Everyone wants the New Awesome

              Merchant Video

              Galaxy A57 5G - Everyone wants the New Awesome


            1. Three lenses. One powerful camera


              Shoot, edit and share special moments with the upgraded camera system. Equipped with a 50 MP OIS Wide-angle Camera, a 12 MP Ultra Wide Camera and a 5 MP Macro Camera, Galaxy A57 5G lets you take photos and videos that are bright, crisp and totally share-worthy. And with 12 MP Super HDR support on the Front Camera, videos are more vibrant than ever.

            2. Bright videos, even at night


              Conquer the night and capture unforgettable bright moments with optimized Nightography. The Wide Camera supports enhanced ISP for faster image processing that drastically reduces the amount of absorbed noise, for clearer details with less blur in your night shots. The camera sensor also features 1.0 um big pixels, absorbing more for brighter and true-to-life videos in low-light conditions.

            3. Super HDR. Ready-to-post selfies


              Live streaming or shooting a video, make sure you get your best angle with Super HDR. Galaxy A57 5G's Front Camera optimizes selfie videos by enhancing saturation and boosting color and contrast. Backgrounds are rendered in sharp, vivid detail for vibrant results every time.

            4. Make every shot iconic


              Capture portraits with enhanced details using AI Segmentation. The rear camera system automatically identifies the background, foreground and sky in photos, and instantly improves the image quality in elements such as the skin, face, hair and grass. Capture a broader field of view with Galaxy A57 5G's Ultra Wide Camera.

            1. Ultimately slim, strikingly sleek


              Redesigned front to back and ready to make an impression. The Galaxy A57 5G is slimmer than ever before and features a strikingly sleek silhouette with a modern glossy finish that grabs the attention. It's also lighter compared to the previous model and feels comfortable to hold in one hand. On the back, the Triple Camera is elevated on a camera bump that catches the eye with an elegant translucent effect, making it a visual standout for everyone to see.

            2. Glossy glass finish. Modern look


              The glossy glass finish on the back of Galaxy A57 5G has a modern glazed ceramic look that levels up your style. Choose from four comforting, calming colors in a dark or light hue to match your vibe—Awesome Navy, Awesome Icyblue or Awesome Lilac.

            3. Made to last with IP68 water resistance


              Embark on your daily adventures confidently with Galaxy A57 5G. IP68 protection means your phone is safe from dirt and splashes, while the solid frame keeps your Galaxy A57 5G looking clean and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+ delivers durability and scratch resistance.

            4. Built to last with 6x OS and security upgrades


              Enjoy your phone for years with updated and secure long-term software support. Galaxy A57 5G includes support for up to 6x OS upgrades, offering ways to create, connect and stay productive with seamless actions and device management features. Plus, stay ahead of security threats with 6 years of Security and Maintenance releases.

            1. Circle it, Find it


              Use Circle to Search with Google to find multiple items of a look by simply circling an outfit on your screen, and it will help you find every piece — from tops to footwear and everything in between — all in one search. You can circle it, search it and find the look, all from exactly where you are.

            2. Object Eraser. Instant edits, natural results


              Erase unwanted objects from images Object Eraser on Galaxy A57 5G. The smart AI feature lets you select distractions in the background, remove them seamlessly and fill in the space while maintaining high image quality. The algorithm automatically improves textures and reduces blur in the area around the removed objects, so you can get the result you want each time.

            3. Best Face. All smiles in group pics


              With Best Face on Galaxy A57 5G, enhance your group photos quickly and easily. Just select a group Motion Photo, then choose the most flattering expressions and faces from multiple shots, combining them into a single, awesome photo with everyone smiling.

            4. Edit suggestion. Remaster on the fly


              Experience high-quality editing with Edit suggestion on Galaxy A57 5G. This intelligent feature analyzes the media on your device and provides suggestions for how to improve your images. Add background blur, remaster the resolution, erase shadows and reflections or remaster GIFs with a few simple steps.

            1. High-res visuals on a 17.11cm display


              Get ready to immerse yourself in the expansive visuals of Galaxy A57 5G. The 17.11cm FHD+ Super AMOLED Plus display has slimmer bezels, providing an uninterrupted viewing experience. Whether you're streaming, scrolling or gaming, your view stays clear thanks to Vision Booster.

            2. 2 days of battery on a single charge


              Keep going with the long-lasting 5,000 mAh (typical) battery of Galaxy A57 5G. Enjoy your content, social media or games without needing to recharge your phone for 2 days at a time. And when you need a power boost, plug in for Super Fast Charging 2.0 and get up to 60% charge in just 30 minutes.

            3. Performance with more power, less lag


              Galaxy A57 5G is engineered with an advanced Octa-core processor, delivering powerful performance throughout your day. Play, create and edit content smoothly with reliability and confidence thanks to improved CPU and GPU performance up to 15% compared to the previous model. The upgraded LPDDR5X memory gives a boost to your multitasking, while the larger vapor chamber prevents your phone from heating up—so you can stay cool even in the heat of action-packed gaming.

            4. Storage for everyday moments


              Galaxy A57 5G comes in 256 GB with 12 GB or 8 GB of memory, so you can keep your favorite photos and essential apps for daily use.

            5. Your privacy and data, secured by Samsung Knox


              The EAL5+ certified Knox Vault on Galaxy A57 5G keeps your private information safe and sound. Organize photos with sensitive data into private albums and access them securely. Plus, stay protected with intelligent privacy alerts when apps attempt to access your precise location or sensitive data unnecessarily.

            6. One UI 8.5. Your Galaxy. Your way


              The new One UI 8.5 is capable of doing much more — from taking care of tedious tasks to suggesting what I need at the exact moment to adapting to my personal tastes and usage patterns. With AI integrated deeper into the system, you now have the freedom to be more productive and creative. Experience seamless intelligence of your Galaxy that empowers you to see more, create more and understand more.

            • How good is camera of Galaxy A57 5G?

              Galaxy A57 5G has triple camera- 50MP Wide OIS, 12MP UW and 5MP Macro. Enhanced ISP and Low Noise Mode give improved Nightography. It offers intelligent editing tools like Best Face and Object eraser.

            • How has the design of Galaxy A57 5G been improved?

              Galaxy A57 5G is the slimmest A with 6.9 mm slimness, making it easy to grip in one hand & weighs 179g. Bezels in 6.7-inch Super AMOLED+ display have been slimmed to 1.5mm. It comes with metal frame.

            • Is Galaxy A57 5G durable?

              Galaxy A57 5G gives upto 6x OS upgrades and 6 years of security updates. It has IP68 rating and Gorilla Glass Victus + protection on front and back. It has 5,000 mAh battery that lasts 2 days.

            • Is Galaxy A57 5G fast?

              Galaxy A57 is smooth performance-whether gaming or editing. It has Exynos 1680 where NPU is up by 33% .LPDDR5X and UFS3.1 ensure faster app loading and gaming. It has flagship level vapour cooling.

            • What Samsung exclusive features can I get?

              Choose between in-built Bixby, Gemini and Perplexity. Secure data with EAL5+ certified Samsung Knox Vault. Get latest OneUI8.5. Save your confidential photos in private album. NFC also supported.
